name: Shtriga
description: The shtriga is a vampiric witch in Albanian folklore who feeds on the blood of sleeping infants. After feeding she can transform into a flying insect, and the only sure cure for her victims is a remedy obtained from the shtriga herself. Apotropaic protections include garlic, salt, the sign of the cross, and a cross of pig bone placed at a church door on Easter Sunday.

aliases.name: Strix
aliases.meaning: owl-witch; ancient ancestor of the term

origin: Northern Albanian highlands, Kosovo, and Albanian-speaking communities of North Macedonia and Montenegro; with a wider Balkan continuum of cognate figures.
